text: અમને પૂર્વ દરવાજો જોઈએ, દક્ષિણ નહીં
romanization_iso15919: amanē pūrv daravājō jōīē, dakṣiṇ nahīṁ
ipa: ʌmʌneː puːɾʋ dəɾʋaːɟoː ɟoːiːeː, dəkʃɪɳ nʌhĩ
literal: we need the east gate, not the south
we have to catch the fast train
I have to get off here
get me there before the shinkansen

text: ક્યાં ઊતરવાનું છે એ કહી દો
romanization_iso15919: kyāṁ ūtaravānuṁ chē ē kahī dō
ipa: kjã utəɾʋaːnũ cʰeː eː kʌhi doː
literal: tell me where it is to get off
will the vehicle have to be changed?
at how many o clock is the next?
I have come for work (m) — આવી છું for a woman
I have come to meet family (m)
this is for my own use
where will the luggage be got?
how many days is there permission to stay?
may the entry stamp be got?

text: મારી પાસે ખાવાનું કે છોડ નથી
romanization_iso15919: mārī pāsē khāvānuṁ kē chōḍ nathī
ipa: maːɾi paːseː kʰaːʋaːnũ keː cʰoːɖ nʌtʰi
literal: I have no food or plants
must the ticket be got punched?

text: B2 · BPK · bakso જેવા કોડ = ભૂંડનું માંસ
romanization_iso15919: B2 · BPK · bakso jēvā kōḍ = bhūṁḍanuṁ māṁs
literal: codes like B2, BPK and bakso mean pork
